# Introduction

This report collects code for analysing TT-eTAM-seq data.

# Highly confident m6A identification

## mature RNA eTAMseq

```{r}
#| eval: false
#| include: true
path_data <- "~/Desktop/Data/Julian_lab/Sarah/eTAMseq/imb_koenig_2024_13_hallstein_eTAMseq_HEK293T/AandGcounts/"
file_etam <- list.files(path_data)
thresh_count <- 5

getstr <- 
function(mystring, initial.character, dijige_str_ini = 1,final.character, dijige_str_final = 1 ,plus1 = F){
    # check that all 3 inputs are character variables
    if (!is.character(mystring))
    {
        stop('The parent string must be a character variable.')
    }

    if (!is.character(initial.character))
    {
        stop('The initial character must be a character variable.')
    }


    if (!is.character(final.character))
    {
        stop('The final character must be a character variable.')
    }



    # pre-allocate a vector to store the extracted strings
    snippet = rep(0, length(mystring))



    for (i in 1:length(mystring))
    {
        # extract the initial position
        initial.position = gregexpr(initial.character, mystring[i])[[1]][dijige_str_ini] + nchar(initial.character)

        if (plus1 == T) {
            final.position = gregexpr(final.character, mystring[i])[[1]][dijige_str_final] - nchar(final.character) + 1
        }
        else{
            # extract the final position
            final.position = gregexpr(final.character, mystring[i])[[1]][dijige_str_final] - nchar(final.character)
        }

        # extract the substring between the initial and final positions, inclusively
        snippet[i] = substr(mystring[i], initial.position, final.position)
    }

    return(snippet)
}

list_etam <- list()

## read all data into a list
for (i in 1:8) {
    df_etam <- read_tsv(paste0(path_data, file_etam[i]), col_names = FALSE)
    colnames(df_etam) <- c("seqnames", "start", "end", "Acount", "Gcount", "strand")
    df_etam$coverage <- df_etam$Acount + df_etam$Gcount
    df_etam <- df_etam[df_etam$coverage > thresh_count,]
    ## must to use end instead of start to make sure the coordinates are correct (bed file issue)
    df_etam$ID <- paste0(df_etam$seqnames,":", df_etam$end, " ", df_etam$strand)
    list_etam[[i]] <- df_etam
    names(list_etam)[[i]] <- getstr(file_etam[i], "_", 5, "\\.", 1,plus1 = T)
    print(paste0(file_etam[i], " finished"))
}
tmp <- c()
## keep the unique position which have signal
for (i in 1:length(list_etam)) {
    tmp <- c(tmp, list_etam[[i]]$ID)
}
eTAM_data <- data.frame(ID = unique(tmp)) 

## make the big table content all data
for (i in 1:8) {
    ## Assign A and G count for each position
    eTAM_data[,paste0("Acount_", names(list_etam)[i])] <- 
        list_etam[[i]]$Acount[match(eTAM_data$ID, list_etam[[i]]$ID)]
    eTAM_data[,paste0("Gcount_", names(list_etam)[i])] <- 
        list_etam[[i]]$Gcount[match(eTAM_data$ID, list_etam[[i]]$ID)]
    eTAM_data[,paste0("Cov_", names(list_etam)[i])] <- 
        list_etam[[i]]$coverage[match(eTAM_data$ID, list_etam[[i]]$ID)]
}
## make NA to 0
eTAM_data[is.na(eTAM_data)] <- 0

m6A_arbi_HEK <- eTAM_data
## convert df to GRanges
m6A_arbi_HEK$seqnames <- gsub(":.*", "", m6A_arbi_HEK$ID)
m6A_arbi_HEK$start <- m6A_arbi_HEK$end <- gsub(".*:", "", m6A_arbi_HEK$ID) %>% gsub(" .*", "", .)
m6A_arbi_HEK$strand <- gsub(".* ", "", m6A_arbi_HEK$ID)
m6A_arbi_HEK <- makeGRangesFromDataFrame(m6A_arbi_HEK, keep.extra.columns = T)
m6A_arbi_HEK <- m6A_arbi_HEK[seqnames(m6A_arbi_HEK) %in% standardChromosomes(m6A_arbi_HEK)]
names(m6A_arbi_HEK) <- NULL

## calculating mean A2A ratio 
## DMSO samples
m6A_arbi_HEK$A2A_dmso_1 <- m6A_arbi_HEK$Acount_DMSO1/m6A_arbi_HEK$Cov_DMSO1
m6A_arbi_HEK$A2A_dmso_2 <- m6A_arbi_HEK$Acount_DMSO2/m6A_arbi_HEK$Cov_DMSO2
m6A_arbi_HEK$A2A_dmso_3 <- m6A_arbi_HEK$Acount_DMSO3/m6A_arbi_HEK$Cov_DMSO3
m6A_arbi_HEK$A2A_dmso_4 <- m6A_arbi_HEK$Acount_DMSO4/m6A_arbi_HEK$Cov_DMSO4
## STM samples
m6A_arbi_HEK$A2A_stm_1 <- m6A_arbi_HEK$Acount_STM1/m6A_arbi_HEK$Cov_STM1
m6A_arbi_HEK$A2A_stm_2 <- m6A_arbi_HEK$Acount_STM2/m6A_arbi_HEK$Cov_STM2
m6A_arbi_HEK$A2A_stm_3 <- m6A_arbi_HEK$Acount_STM3/m6A_arbi_HEK$Cov_STM3
m6A_arbi_HEK$A2A_stm_4 <- m6A_arbi_HEK$Acount_STM4/m6A_arbi_HEK$Cov_STM4

## Mean
m6A_arbi_HEK$mean_A2A_dmso <-
    rowMeans(mcols(m6A_arbi_HEK)[,c("A2A_dmso_1", "A2A_dmso_2", "A2A_dmso_3", "A2A_dmso_4")] %>% 
                 as.data.frame(.), na.rm = T)
m6A_arbi_HEK$mean_A2A_stm <-
    rowMeans(mcols(m6A_arbi_HEK)[,c("A2A_stm_1", "A2A_stm_2", "A2A_stm_3", "A2A_stm_4")] %>% 
                 as.data.frame(.), na.rm = T)

## Coverage mean
m6A_arbi_HEK$mean_cov_dmso <- 
    (m6A_arbi_HEK$Cov_DMSO1+m6A_arbi_HEK$Cov_DMSO2+
         m6A_arbi_HEK$Cov_DMSO3+m6A_arbi_HEK$Cov_DMSO4)/4
m6A_arbi_HEK$mean_cov_stm <- 
    (m6A_arbi_HEK$Cov_STM1+m6A_arbi_HEK$Cov_STM2+
         m6A_arbi_HEK$Cov_STM3+m6A_arbi_HEK$Cov_STM4)/4

# saveRDS(m6A_arbi_HEK, "rds/all_mature_eTAM_hek.rds")
## filtering for have certain coverage in both condition
m6A_arbi_HEK <- m6A_arbi_HEK[which(m6A_arbi_HEK$mean_cov_dmso > 15 & m6A_arbi_HEK$mean_cov_stm >15)]
m6A_arbi_HEK$dif_A2A <- m6A_arbi_HEK$mean_A2A_dmso - m6A_arbi_HEK$mean_A2A_stm

m6A_arbi_HEK$m6A <- ifelse(m6A_arbi_HEK$dif_A2A >= 0.25, "m6A", "background")
```

## TT-eTAMseq

```{r}
## Data loading
eTAM_data <- readRDS("~/Desktop/Data/Julian_lab/Peter/eTAM/TT_eTAM_STM/TT_eTAM_f.rds")
## convert df to GRanges
eTAM_data$seqnames <- gsub(":.*", "", eTAM_data$ID)
eTAM_data$start <- eTAM_data$end <- gsub(".*:", "", eTAM_data$ID) %>% gsub(" .*", "", .)
eTAM_data$strand <- gsub(".* ", "", eTAM_data$ID)
eTAM_data <- makeGRangesFromDataFrame(eTAM_data, keep.extra.columns = T)
eTAM_data <- eTAM_data[seqnames(eTAM_data) %in% standardChromosomes(eTAM_data)]
names(eTAM_data) <- NULL

## calculating mean A2A ratio 
## DMSO samples
eTAM_data$A2A_dmso_1 <- eTAM_data$Acount_DMSO_rep1/eTAM_data$Cov_DMSO_rep1
eTAM_data$A2A_dmso_2 <- eTAM_data$Acount_DMSO_rep2/eTAM_data$Cov_DMSO_rep2
eTAM_data$A2A_dmso_3 <- eTAM_data$Acount_DMSO_rep3/eTAM_data$Cov_DMSO_rep3
eTAM_data$A2A_dmso_4 <- eTAM_data$Acount_DMSO_rep4/eTAM_data$Cov_DMSO_rep4
## STM samples
eTAM_data$A2A_stm_1 <- eTAM_data$Acount_STM2457_rep1/eTAM_data$Cov_STM2457_rep1
eTAM_data$A2A_stm_2 <- eTAM_data$Acount_STM2457_rep2/eTAM_data$Cov_STM2457_rep2
eTAM_data$A2A_stm_3 <- eTAM_data$Acount_STM2457_rep3/eTAM_data$Cov_STM2457_rep3
eTAM_data$A2A_stm_4 <- eTAM_data$Acount_STM2457_rep4/eTAM_data$Cov_STM2457_rep4

## Mean
eTAM_data$mean_A2A_dmso <-
    rowMeans(mcols(eTAM_data)[,c(grep("A2A_dmso", colnames(mcols(eTAM_data))))] %>% 
                 as.data.frame(.), na.rm = T)
eTAM_data$mean_A2A_stm <-
    rowMeans(mcols(eTAM_data)[,c(grep("A2A_stm", colnames(mcols(eTAM_data))))] %>% 
                 as.data.frame(.), na.rm = T)

## Coverage mean
eTAM_data$mean_cov_dmso <- 
    (eTAM_data$Cov_DMSO_rep1+eTAM_data$Cov_DMSO_rep2+
         eTAM_data$Cov_DMSO_rep3+eTAM_data$Cov_DMSO_rep4)/4
eTAM_data$mean_cov_stm <- 
    (eTAM_data$Cov_STM2457_rep1+eTAM_data$Cov_STM2457_rep2+
         eTAM_data$Cov_STM2457_rep3+eTAM_data$Cov_STM2457_rep4)/4
## filtering for have certain coverage in both condition
eTAM_data <- eTAM_data[which(eTAM_data$mean_cov_dmso > 15 & eTAM_data$mean_cov_stm >15)]
eTAM_data$dif_A2A <- eTAM_data$mean_A2A_dmso - eTAM_data$mean_A2A_stm
eTAM_data$m6A  <- ifelse(eTAM_data$dif_A2A >= 0.25, "m6A", "background")
```

```{r}
tmp <-eTAM_data[eTAM_data$m6A == "m6A"] 
tmp$score <- tmp$mean_A2A_dmso
export.bed(tmp, "rds/m6A_TTeTAM.bed")
```

## TT-eTAM m6A location

```{r}
m6A_assignment_intron_version <- function(gr, anno){
    
    ## processing anno
    exon <- anno[anno$type == "exon"]
    tran_length <- as.data.frame(exon) %>% group_by(transcript_id, gene_id) %>%
        summarise(trans_len = sum(width), .groups = "drop")

    exon$trans_len <- tran_length$trans_len[match(exon$transcript_id, tran_length$transcript_id)]
    exon$exon_number <- as.numeric(exon$exon_number)

    exon <- as.data.frame(exon) %>% group_by(transcript_id) %>%
        mutate(exon_total = max(exon_number)) %>%
        makeGRangesFromDataFrame(., keep.extra.columns = T)
    exon <- exon[order(exon$level, exon$transcript_support_level, -exon$trans_len)]

    gene <- anno[anno$type == "gene"]
    
    ## save the used for later usage
    used <- anno[anno$type %in%c("exon")]
    used$transcript_length <- exon$trans_len[match(used$transcript_id, exon$transcript_id)]
    
    ## get intron annotation
    exon$exonID <- paste0(exon$transcript_id, ",", exon$exon_number)
    introns <- setdiff(gene, exon)
    o <- findOverlaps(introns, gene, select = "first")
    introns$gene_id <- gene$gene_id[o]
    introns$gene_name <- gene$gene_name[o]
    
    ## assgined first to annotations
    used <- used[order(used$level, used$transcript_support_level,
                                   -used$transcript_length)]
    introns$type <- "intron"
    introns$transcript_id <- NA
    merge_anno <- c(introns, used)
    
    ## assign the sites based on the hirachy
    o <- findOverlaps(gr, merge_anno, select = "first")
    
    gr$type <- merge_anno$type[o]
    gr$gene_id <- merge_anno$gene_id[o]
    gr$transcript_id <- merge_anno$transcript_id[o]
    gr$gene_name <- merge_anno$gene_name[o]
    return(gr)
}
```

```{r}
)]

)]

    m6A_mature$ID, All_m6A$ID
)]
m6A_mature$cov_wt_tt <- All_m6A$cov_tt_dmso[match(
    m6A_mature$ID, All_m6A$ID
)]

## Since without enough coverage in TT-eTAM the stoichiometry difference would be not reliable
## Here we filter for coverage in TT-eTAM before identify different m6A groups 
m6A_mature$stoi_dif <- m6A_mature$mean_A2A_dmso - m6A_mature$A2A_tt_wt
m6A_mature$groups <- cut(m6A_mature$stoi_dif, c(-Inf,0,0.1,0.2,0.3,0.4,1))
```

```{r}
#| eval: false

## scatter version 2
# ---- 1. Settings -------------------------------------------------------------

infile      <- "stoichiometry_sites.tsv"   # your file
col_A       <- "stoi_A"                    # column: stoichiometry condition A
col_B       <- "stoi_B"                    # column: stoichiometry condition B
cutoff_A    <- 25                          # minimum stoichiometry in A [%]
font_family <- "Arial"                     # use "Helvetica" on macOS if Arial is missing
panel_cm    <- 3                           # axis length in cm
out_prefix  <- "stoi"

# position of the "x % higher in B" label inside the scatter (in % units)
lab_B_x <- 82
lab_B_y <- 42

# colours (same as the binned version)
col_le0  <- "#2B5C6B"   # <= 0   (used for "higher in B")
col_0_10 <- "#4A9A9A"
col_10   <- "#A3D5C3"   # +10 line / 10-20 bin
col_20   <- "#E3A83E"   # +20 line / 20-30 bin
col_30   <- "#C0632A"   # +30 line / 30-40 bin
col_40   <- "#8B3A2F"   # +40 line / >40 bin
bin_cols <- c(col_le0, col_0_10, col_10, col_20, col_30, col_40)
bin_labs <- c("\u2264 0", "0\u201310", "10\u201320", "20\u201330", "30\u201340", "> 40")

# ---- 2. Unit helpers (ggplot uses mm for text and its own scale for lines) ---

fs  <- 6 / .pt                          # 6 pt text inside geom_text/annotate
lw  <- function(pt) pt / (.pt * 72.27 / 96)   # line width in pt -> ggplot linewidth

# ---- 4. Common theme ---------------------------------------------------------

theme_panel <- theme_classic(base_size = 6, base_family = font_family) +
  theme(
    axis.line         = element_line(linewidth = lw(0.5)),
    axis.ticks        = element_line(linewidth = lw(0.5)),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(2, "pt"),
    axis.text         = element_text(size = 6, colour = "black"),
    axis.text.x       = element_text(margin = margin(t = 0.5, unit = "pt")),
    axis.text.y       = element_text(margin = margin(r = 0.5, unit = "pt")),
    axis.title        = element_text(size = 6),
    axis.title.x      = element_text(margin = margin(t = 1.5, unit = "pt")),
    axis.title.y      = element_text(margin = margin(r = 1.5, unit = "pt")),
    plot.title        = element_text(size = 6, hjust = 0,
                                     margin = margin(b = 3, unit = "pt")),
    plot.margin       = margin(12, 8, 3, 3, unit = "pt"),
    legend.position   = "none"
  )

# fix the panel (axis area) to an exact size and save with the matching canvas
save_fixed <- function(p, file, w_cm = panel_cm, h_cm = panel_cm) {
  g  <- ggplotGrob(p)
  pn <- g$layout[g$layout$name == "panel", ]
  g$widths[pn$l]  <- unit(w_cm, "cm")
  g$heights[pn$t] <- unit(h_cm, "cm")
  W <- convertWidth(sum(g$widths),   "cm", valueOnly = TRUE)
  H <- convertHeight(sum(g$heights), "cm", valueOnly = TRUE)
  ggsave(file, g, width = W, height = H, units = "cm", device = cairo_pdf)
  ggsave(sub("\\.pdf$", ".png", file), g, width = W, height = H,
         units = "cm", dpi = 600)
  message(sprintf("%s: %.2f x %.2f cm", file, W, H))
}

# ---- 5. Scatter A vs B with dashed coloured guide lines ----------------------

guides <- tibble(
  k     = c(0, 10, 20, 30, 40),
  lab   = c("\u00b10", "+10", "+20", "+30", "+40"),
  col   = c("black", col_10, col_20, col_30, col_40),
  x0    = 0, y0 = k, x1 = 100 - k, y1 = 100
)

n_sites <- length(m6A_mature_f)
pct_A   <- round(100 * mean(m6A_mature_f$stoi_dif > 0))
pct_B   <- round(100 * mean(m6A_mature_f$stoi_dif <= 0))
med     <- median(m6A_mature_f$stoi_dif*100)

p_scatter <- ggplot(as.data.frame(m6A_mature_f), aes(y = mean_A2A_dmso*100, x = A2A_tt_wt*100)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 0, xmax = 100, ymin = 0, ymax = cutoff_A,
           fill = "#f6f6f6") +
  annotate("text", x = 97, y = cutoff_A / 2,
           label = paste0("minimum stoichiometry\nin A set to ", cutoff_A, " %"),
           hjust = 1, size = fs, colour = "#b0b0b0", lineheight = 0.9,
           family = font_family) +
  ggrastr::rasterise(
      geom_point(size = 0.15, stroke = 0, colour = "#444444", alpha = 0.3), dpi = 600) +
  # guide lines: +10 ... +40 dashed and coloured, diagonal solid black
  geom_segment(data = filter(guides, k > 0),
               aes(x = x0, y = y0, xend = x1, yend = y1, colour = col),
               linewidth = lw(0.5), linetype = "32", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_segment(data = filter(guides, k == 0),
               aes(x = x0, y = y0, xend = x1, yend = y1),
               colour = "black", linewidth = lw(0.6), inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_text(data = guides,
            aes(x = x1 + 1.5, y = y1 + 1.5, label = lab, colour = col),
            angle = 45, hjust = 0, vjust = 0, size = fs,
            family = font_family, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_colour_identity() +
  # label for sites below the diagonal
  annotate("text", x = lab_B_x, y = lab_B_y,
           label = paste0(pct_B, " % higher\nin B"),
           size = fs, colour = col_le0, lineheight = 0.9,
           family = font_family) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 100, 25), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 100, 25), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 100), ylim = c(0, 100), clip = "off") +
  labs(x = "Stoichiometry in TT-eTAM [%]", y = "Stoichiometry eTAM [%]",
       title = paste0(pct_A, " % higher in A")) +
  theme_panel

save_fixed(p_scatter, "plots/stoi_scatter_dashed.pdf")

# ---- 6. Histogram of delta (2 pp bins, coloured by delta bin) ----------------

bw     <- 2
brks   <- seq(floor(min(m6A_mature_f$stoi_dif*100, na.rm = T) / bw) * bw,
              ceiling(max(m6A_mature_f$stoi_dif*100, na.rm = T) / bw) * bw, by = bw)
h      <- hist(m6A_mature_f$stoi_dif*100, breaks = brks, right = TRUE, plot = FALSE)

hist_df <- tibble(mid = h$mids, n = h$counts) %>%
  mutate(bin = cut(mid, c(-Inf, 0, 10, 20, 30, 40, Inf),
                   labels = bin_labs, right = TRUE))

ymax <- max(hist_df$n) / 1000 * 1.05

p_hist <- ggplot(hist_df, aes(mid, n / 1000, fill = bin)) +
  geom_col(width = bw, colour = "white", linewidth = lw(0.15)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0,   colour = "black", linewidth = lw(0.6)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = med, colour = "black", linewidth = lw(0.5),
             linetype = "42") +
  annotate("text", x = med + 1.5, y = ymax,
           label = paste0("median +", round(med), " pp"),
           hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = fs, family = font_family) +
  # share below zero, left of the zero line
  annotate("text", x = -1.5, y = ymax,
           label = paste0(pct_B, " %\nhigher\nin B"),
           hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = fs, colour = col_le0,
           lineheight = 0.9, family = font_family) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = setNames(bin_cols, bin_labs)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-100, 100, 20), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, ymax), clip = "off") +
  labs(x = "\u0394 stoichiometry A \u2212 B [pp]", y = "Sites (\u00d7 1,000)",
       title = paste0(pct_A, " % higher in A")) +
  theme_panel

save_fixed(p_hist, "plots/stoi_dif_hist_delta.pdf")
```

# Factors which facilitates early m6A deposition

## Chromatin accessibility

To check the link between chromatin accessibility and m6A deposition here we used the ATACseq data
and DNase-seq data from `GSE108513`.

```{r}
#| eval: false
#| include: true

ch <- rtracklayer::import.chain("hg19ToHg38.over.chain")
## ATAC
tmp <- import.bw("~/Desktop/Data/GEO/ATAC_DNase_hek_GSE108513/GSM2902628_HEK293_ATAC_medium_depth_bio1_tech1.bw")
tmp <- unlist(liftOver(tmp, ch))

## make rle
tmp <- coverage(tmp, weight = "score")

m6A_mature_f$ATAC <- as.matrix(tmp[m6A_mature_f+10]) %>% rowSums(.)

## DNase
tmp <- import.bw("~/Desktop/Data/GEO/ATAC_DNase_hek_GSE108513/GSM2902639_HEK293_DNase.bw")
tmp <- unlist(liftOver(tmp, ch))

## make rle
tmp <- coverage(tmp, weight = "score")

saveRDS(m6A_mature_f, "rds/m6A_mature_f_with_chr_accessibility.rds")
```

## RNA secondary structure

To get the accessibility of m6A sites in different group, I run the Viennarna RNAfold with following
code.

``` ruby
source ~/.bashrc
conda activate rna_access

set -euo pipefail
FASTA=/home/yoz88dx/data/Fasta/m6A_groups/m6A_seq_201.fasta                     # multi‑FASTA with 201‑nt sequences
OUT=accessibility_m6A_groups.csv

###############################################################################
# 1. run everything in a disposable work directory so files don’t clutter cwd
###############################################################################
WORK=$(mktemp -d)
cp "$FASTA" "$WORK/in.fa"
(
  cd "$WORK" || exit 1

  # --- single RNAplfold run for all records -------------------------------
  RNAplfold -W 201 -L 200 -u 1 < in.fa >/dev/null
)

###############################################################################
# 2. parse each *_lunp (new) or *_unpaired (old) file for Pu(101)
###############################################################################
echo "id,P_unpaired_center" > "$OUT"

for FILE in "$WORK"/*_lunp "$WORK"/*_unpaired; do
  [[ -e "$FILE" ]] || continue               # skip unmatched glob
  ID=${FILE##*/}; ID=${ID%_*}                # strip path & suffix

  # pick the number where first field == 101  -->  second field
  Pu=$(awk '$1==101 {print $2; exit}' "$FILE")

  echo "$ID,$Pu" >> "$OUT"
done

rm -rf "$WORK"
```


## Intron half lives

```{r}
intron_hl <- readRDS("~/Desktop/Project/Julian_lab/m6A_splicing_deposition_code/04 Splicing speed and nuclear residence time/rds/gr_intron_HLs_3_timepoint_3_reps.rds")

## Filter for rmse to keep the high confidence result
intron_hl <- intron_hl[intron_hl$weighted_rmse < 0.1]
intron_hl <- intron_hl[intron_hl$half_life_min < max(intron_hl$half_life_min)]

m6A_mature_f$test_start <- m6A_mature_f$exon_start

m6A_mature_f$test_end <- m6A_mature_f$exon_end

## start
test_start <- data.frame(ID = m6A_mature_f$ID,
                         chr = seqnames(m6A_mature_f),
                         start = m6A_mature_f$test_start,
                         end = m6A_mature_f$test_start,
                         strand = strand(m6A_mature_f)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(start)) %>%
    makeGRangesFromDataFrame(., keep.extra.columns = T)

test_start$hl_SS <- intron_hl$half_life_min[
    findOverlaps((test_start+10), intron_hl, select = "first")]

## end
test_end <- data.frame(ID = m6A_mature_f$ID,
                         chr = seqnames(m6A_mature_f),
                         start = m6A_mature_f$test_end,
                         end = m6A_mature_f$test_end,
                         strand = strand(m6A_mature_f)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(start)) %>%
    makeGRangesFromDataFrame(., keep.extra.columns = T)

## load splicing speed data
test_end$hl_SS <- intron_hl$half_life_min[
    findOverlaps((test_end+10), intron_hl, select = "first")]

m6A_mature_f$hl_SS_start <- test_start$hl_SS[
    match(m6A_mature_f$ID, test_start$ID)
]
m6A_mature_f$hl_SS_end <- test_end$hl_SS[
    match(m6A_mature_f$ID, test_end$ID)
]

m6A_mature_f$hl_SS_mean <- rowMeans(mcols(m6A_mature_f)[, c("hl_SS_start", "hl_SS_end")] %>%
                                          as.data.frame(.),
                                      na.rm = T)

p <- ggplot(as.data.frame(m6A_mature_f[!is.na(m6A_mature_f$bin_nascent_stoi)]), 
       aes(x = bin_nascent_stoi, y = hl_SS_mean)) + 
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) + 
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0,40)) + 
    labs(y = "The intron half lives of surrounding introns (mean value)",
         x = "Stoichiometry in TT_eTAM")
gt <- fix_panel_size(p, panel_width = panel_width, panel_height = panel_height)
grid::grid.newpage()
grid::grid.draw(gt)
```

# m6A distribution in groups

```{r}
m6A_mature_f$Position[m6A_mature_f$location == "CDS"] <- 
    m6A_mature_f$Position[m6A_mature_f$location == "CDS"] + 1
m6A_mature_f$Position[m6A_mature_f$location == "UTR3"] <- 
    m6A_mature_f$Position[m6A_mature_f$location == "UTR3"] + 2
```

```{r}
p <- ggplot(as.data.frame(m6A_mature_f[m6A_mature_f$location != "NO"]), 
       aes(x = Position, color = groups)) +
    geom_density(fill = "white", alpha= 0.05)  +
    ggtitle("Metagene profile") +
    geom_vline(xintercept=c(1,2), linetype=2, color="cornflowerblue") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0.5,1.5,2.5),
                       labels = c("5'UTR","CDS","3'UTR"))
gt <- fix_panel_size(p, panel_width = panel_width, panel_height = panel_height)
grid::grid.newpage()
grid::grid.draw(gt)
```

```{r}
p <- ggplot(as.data.frame(m6A_mature_f[m6A_mature_f$location != "NO"]), 
       aes(fill = location, x = groups)) + 
    geom_bar(position = "fill") + 
    labs(y = "Accumulated fraction", x = "Difference of stoichiometry (mature - nascent)")
gt <- fix_panel_size(p, panel_width = panel_width, panel_height = panel_height)
grid::grid.newpage()
grid::grid.draw(gt)
```

# Nascent to mature ratio

```{r}
m6A_mature_f$nascent_mature_ratio <- m6A_mature_f$A2A_tt_wt/m6A_mature_f$mean_A2A_dmso

p <- ggplot(as.data.frame(m6A_mature_f),
       aes(x = nascent_mature_ratio)) + 
    stat_ecdf() + 
    geom_vline(xintercept = median(m6A_mature_f$nascent_mature_ratio), linetype = 2) +
    labs(y= "Accumulated fraction", x = "Nascent to mature m6A stoichiometry ratio",
         title = "The dash line represents median value") + 
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0,0.5,round(median(m6A_mature_f$nascent_mature_ratio),3), 1,1.5,2),
                       labels = c(0,0.5,round(median(m6A_mature_f$nascent_mature_ratio),3), 1,1.5,2))

gt <- fix_panel_size(p, panel_width = panel_width, panel_height = panel_height)
grid::grid.newpage()
grid::grid.draw(gt)
```

# Supplement table for m6A sites

```{r}
## mature
m6A_mature_df <- as.data.frame(m6A_mature)
m6A_mature_df$Stoichiometry <- m6A_mature_df$mean_A2A_dmso
m6A_mature_df <- m6A_mature_df[,c(1,2,3,4,5,58)]

write.xlsx(m6A_mature_df, "tables/m6A_eTAM_mature.xlsx")

## TT-eTAM
m6A_tt_df <- as.data.frame(m6A_tt) %>%
    mutate(Stoichiometry = mean_A2A_dmso,
           Location = type)

m6A_tt_df <- m6A_tt_df[,c(1:5,57,58,55)]
write.xlsx(m6A_tt_df, "tables/m6A_TTeTAM_nascent.xlsx")
```
